of these schools and to build a more just and inclusive future.

The Truth and Reconciliation Commission's (TRC) final report shone a light on Canada's residential school system, a dark chapter in our history with lasting impacts still felt by Indigenous people today. Ontario is working with Indigenous partners to address the legacy of these schools and to build a more just and inclusive future.

As part of the TRC's mandate, the Canadian government adopted the 94 Calls to Action. These calls to action are a roadmap for achieving reconciliation by addressing the ongoing impacts of the residential school system. These calls to action cover a wide range of areas, including education, health, justice, and community development, and they are a key part of the national reconciliation process.

Ontario is committed to implementing these Calls to Action, and we have taken many steps to support this work. In 2015, the Ontario government launched the Ontario Human Rights Commission's (OHRC) Truth and Reconciliation Strategy
